note: Flat faces of the Nezu phoenix fanghu from the project owner's photo-08 (the broad face, near head-on, ≈ 3.2 px/mm on the belly). Points are [photo px, vessel mm x, y, z]: each zone's chord-plane corners, edge midpoints and centre projected through an ASSUMED pinhole camera (.work/r8-fanghu/solve/fit08.py: az 4.4°, el 6° assumed, 965 mm from (0, 250, 0), f 3000 px; fitted to the silhouette at 11 levels and four centre-line landmarks, 7.9 px rms). They are a consistent flattening of the photograph under that camera, not an independent measurement. The décor itself was traced on faces/dev-*.jpg (the same photograph developed onto the model's own curved surface, reference/nezu-fanghu/trace.py); these planar faces are the instrument for comparing photo and model head-on.

p08.note: the project owner's photograph, Nezu Museum, Tokyo, 2026; the committed file is the original
